title: Kenyan Fried Rice
description: A flavorful twist on the classic fried rice dish, inspired by Kenyan cuisine.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped scallions and toasted peanuts and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Push the scallions and peanuts to one side of the pan.
Add the zesty to the empty side of the pan and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the crispy rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the Kenyan rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Mix all the ingredients together and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Serve hot and garnish with additional scallions and peanuts if desired.
Cook for 15 minutes and serve immediately.
